message.name: SecuritiesTransactionCancellationRequestStatusAdviceV09
message.definition: Scope|An account servicer sends an SecuritiesTransactionCancellationRequestStatusAdvice to an account owner to advise the status of a securities transaction cancellation request previously sent by the account owner.|The account servicer/owner relationship may be:|- a central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure acting on behalf of their participants|- an agent (sub-custodian) acting on behalf of their global custodian customer, or|- a custodian acting on behalf of an investment management institution or a broker/dealer.||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information|using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

rules.name: ShortLongNumberRule
rules.text: ShortNumber must contain the FIN message type number of the linked message. LongNumber must contain the XML message identifier of the linked message.

rules.name: NoAccountOwnerTransactionIdentificationRule
rules.text: If no reference is available for the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification, for example, the transaction was sent by fax, then the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification must be NONREF.

rules.name: AdditionalReasonInforrmationRule
rules.text: The AdditionalReasonInformation element must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rule
rules.text: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rule
rules.text: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

rules.name: Party2PresenceRule
rules.text: If Party2 is present, then Party1 must be present.

rules.name: Party3PresenceRule
rules.text: If Party3 is present, then Party2 must be present.

rules.name: Party4PresenceRule
rules.text: If Party4 is present, then Party3 must be present.

rules.name: Party5PresenceRule
rules.text: If Party5 is present, then Party4 must be present.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rule
rules.text: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rule
rules.text: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Rule
rules.text: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: SecuritiesMarketPracticeGroupGuideline
rules.text: The Securities Market Practice Group (SMPG) has published market practice recommendations on the use of this message.|These market practices are available on www.smpg.info.
